name: com.akaitoai.universal-mount-system
description: Controller-agnostic, transactional mount and interaction system for Unity. Easily integrate with any third-person controller, any type of mount (vehicles, animals, turrets, boats, aircraft), and any number of mounts or seats.

samples.description: Minimal zero-dependency example scripts (third-person controller, mount controller, and follow camera) demonstrating plug-and-play integration.
